처음 방문할 때 무엇을 준비하면 되나요?: What should I prepare for my first visit?
신분증, 복용 약 목록이나 처방전, 이전 치료 기록이 있다면 준비해 주세: Bring ID, list of medications or prescriptions, and previous treatment records if any. Sedation requires pre-evaluation and separate preparation, so mention at booking.
일요일에도 진료하나요?: Do you see patients on Sundays?
청량리 본점은 일요일 10:00~14:00 진료합니다. 광명사거리점은 일: Cheongnyangni main branch treats Sundays 10:00~14:00. Gwangmyeong Sageori is closed on Sundays. Confirm temporary closures or holiday schedules by phone before visiting.
장애가 있거나 거동이 불편해도 상담할 수 있나요?: Can I consult if I have a disability or limited mobility?
상담 가능합니다. 이동 방법과 진료 자세, 의사소통에 필요한 도움을 미리: Consultation is available. Please inform in advance about mobility methods, treatment posture and communication support needed. Branch-specific accessibility and possible treatment range will be confirmed at booking.
I don’t know which director I should see.
현재 불편한 증상과 기존 치료 여부를 알려주시면 상담을 통해 진료 분야를: Tell us current symptoms and prior treatment and we will guide the treatment field by consultation. Confirm director branch and schedule by phone.
수면치료를 예약하면 당일 바로 진행되나요?: If I book sedation, will it be done the same day?
진정의 적합성, 금식 여부, 보호자 동반 및 치료 계획을 먼저 확인해야: Assess sedation suitability, fasting, need for guardian accompaniment and treatment plan first. Without pre-evaluation, same-day procedure is not guaranteed.
지점별 주차 위치와 지원 조건은 전화로 확인해 주세요. 청량리 본점은 제: Parking locations and support conditions vary by branch; check by phone. Cheongnyangni is near Jegidong Station Exit 2; Gwangmyeong Sageori is near Gwangmyeong Sageori Station Exit 9.
수면 임플란트는 완전히 잠드는 건가요?: Does sedation implant make me completely sleep?
의식이 옅게 남아 있는 진정 상태입니다. 스스로 호흡하고 부르면 반응할: It is a light sedation state with some consciousness remaining. You breathe on your own and may respond when called, but depth and memory vary by individual. Complete sleep or total memory loss is not guaranteed.
의식이 남아 있다면 움직여서 다칠 수도 있지 않나요?: If consciousness remains, could I move and get hurt?
진정이 긴장과 반사적 움직임을 줄이는 데 도움이 될 수 있지만 움직임을: Sedation can help reduce tension and reflexive movement but cannot completely prevent movement. Clinicians monitor responses, breathing and circulation and stop or change the treatment plan if needed.
전신마취와는 무엇이 다른가요?: How is it different from general anesthesia?
의식하진정은 보통 스스로 호흡하고 말이나 자극에 반응할 수 있는 상태입니: Conscious sedation typically allows spontaneous breathing and responses to speech or stimuli. General anesthesia involves unconsciousness and requires airway and breathing management. Sedation can deepen unexpectedly causing respiratory depression, so monitoring and emergency response are needed.
수술 전 금식을 해야 하나요?: Do I need to fast before surgery?
금식은 위 내용물의 역류와 흡인 위험을 줄이기 위해 필요합니다. 음식 종: Fasting reduces risk of reflux and aspiration of stomach contents. Guidelines vary by food type, sedation plan and health status, so follow individualized instructions given at booking. If you ate against guidance, do not hide it — inform us.
먹던 약은 끊어야 하나요?: Should I stop my regular medications?
임의로 중단하지 마시고 알려 주세요. 혈압약처럼 유지해야 하는 약과 항응: Do not stop medications on your own; inform us. Some medications like blood pressure drugs should be continued, while anticoagulants may require adjustment.
수면으로 하면 여러 개를 한 번에 할 수 있나요?: Can multiple procedures be done at once under sedation?
여러 부위의 치료를 한 회차에 묶어 진행할 수 있는 경우가 있습니다. 다: Multiple areas can sometimes be treated in one session. However, consider jawbone and systemic condition and expected surgical time to set a safe scope without overdoing it.
치료 중에는 어떻게 관찰하나요?: How are you monitored during treatment?
진정부터 회복까지 혈압·맥박·산소포화도 등 환자 상태를 관찰합니다. 감시: Monitor blood pressure, pulse and oxygen saturation from sedation through recovery. Monitoring is to detect risks early and does not guarantee absence of complications.
끝나면 바로 집에 갈 수 있나요?: Can I go home immediately afterwards?
회복 시간은 약물과 전신 상태에 따라 다릅니다. 의료진이 회복을 확인한: Recovery time varies by drugs and systemic condition. Clinician confirms recovery and the adult guardian escorts you home. Avoid driving, alcohol, operating machinery, or important decisions the same day and follow individual guidance before resuming activities.
고령이어도 수면으로 수술할 수 있나요?: Can elderly patients have surgery under sedation?
나이만으로 결정하지 않습니다. 전신 상태와 복용 약, 기도 위험, 필요한: Age alone is not a deciding factor. Evaluate systemic condition, medications, airway risk and required surgical time, and assess need for consulting primary doctor or higher-level hospital.
당일 귀가는 어떻게 하나요? 운전해도 되나요?: How do I get home the same day? Can I drive?
운전은 절대 안 됩니다. 판단력과 반응 속도가 완전히 돌아오지 않으므로: Never drive. Judgment and reaction speed may not be fully restored. Always be accompanied by a guardian and avoid using public transportation alone.
수면으로 하면 수술이 더 잘 되나요?: Does sedation make the surgery go better?
진정은 불안과 긴장을 낮추는 방법이지 식립의 정확도나 성공을 보장하는 방: Sedation reduces anxiety and tension but does not guarantee surgical accuracy or success. Position planning, jawbone condition and postoperative care are also important.
추가 비용은 얼마인가요?: How much extra does it cost?
Sedation anesthesia is non-covered and will be explained in advance together with implant costs during consultation.
수면 임플란트는 한 번에 몇 개까지 심을 수 있나요?: How many implants can be placed at once under sedation?
일률적인 개수보다 잇몸뼈와 전신 상태, 예상 수술 시간이 기준입니다. 여: Not a fixed number; jawbone, systemic condition and expected surgical time determine limits. Even if many implants are needed, staged procedures may be more appropriate.
임신 중이거나 수유 중에도 가능한가요?: Is it possible during pregnancy or breastfeeding?
임신 중에는 선택적인 진정 치료를 미루는 경우가 많습니다. 임신 가능성이: Elective sedation is often postponed during pregnancy. Inform us about possible pregnancy or breastfeeding so we can check necessity, drugs and timing and provide individualized guidance.
수면 임플란트 다음 날 출근해도 되나요?: Can I go to work the day after sedation implant?
수면 임플란트는 보험이 되나요?: Is sedation implant covered by insurance?
보험 적용 여부는 연령, 구강 상태, 진료 목적과 항목별 현행 기준에 따: Insurance coverage depends on age, oral condition, treatment purpose and current item criteria. After diagnosis, get a breakdown of covered and non-covered items. Check costs of treatments and sedation separately.
뼈이식이나 상악동거상술을 같이 해도 수면으로 되나요?: Can bone graft or sinus lift be done under sedation too?
의식하진정이 도움이 될 수 있지만 모든 분께 적합하지는 않습니다. 전신: Conscious sedation may help but is not suitable for everyone. Decide after evaluating systemic condition, medications, airway risk and treatment scope; refer to higher-level institutions if needed.
나중에 앞니 잇몸이 검게 비친다던데요?: Will the front gum look dark later?
보철물의 아래쪽 경계가 잇몸 밖으로 드러나면 그 부분이 그림자처럼 검게: If the margin under a prosthesis is exposed beyond the gum it can appear dark like a shadow. If bone or gum around an implant is thin, the gum may recede over time exposing the margin. Securing bone and gum thickness from the start can reduce this issue.
임시치아를 수술 당일에 바로 넣을 수 있나요?: Can I have a temporary tooth placed on the day of surgery?
가능한 경우가 있습니다. 발치 후 즉시 식립하고 당일 임시 보철물까지 장: Possible in some cases. There are cases of immediate placement after extraction with same-day temporary prosthesis. However it depends on inflammation and primary stability and is judged after 3D CT.
옆 치아와 색을 맞출 수 있나요? 티나지 않을까요?: Can the color match adjacent teeth? Will it be noticeable?
원내 자체 기공소에서 색조와 투명도를 확인하며 조정합니다. 자연치아와 완: In-house lab adjusts shade and translucency. Exact match to natural teeth is not guaranteed; modification scope and timing depend on prosthesis status.
브릿지와 임플란트 중 무엇이 나은가요?: Which is better, bridge or implant?
If adjacent teeth are healthy, implants that avoid cutting those teeth can be considered. Bridges use adjacent teeth as supports, so consider adjacent tooth condition, bone status, surgical burden, cost and time together.
앞니 임플란트는 몇 개월 걸리나요?: How many months for front-tooth implants?
골유착과 잇몸 회복에 수개월이 필요할 수 있으며, 뼈이식·잇몸이식 여부에: Months may be needed for osseointegration and gum recovery; bone graft or gum graft may extend time. Use of temporary teeth and expected schedule explained after diagnosis.
앞니 임플란트 비용은 어금니보다 비싼가요?: Are front-tooth implants more expensive than molars?
식립 자체의 비용은 크게 다르지 않지만, 앞니는 잇몸 라인과 색을 맞추는: Placement cost itself is not much different, but front teeth often require matching gum line and color and may need bone and gum grafting, raising total cost. After diagnosis provide written estimate including only necessary items.
앞니 임플란트에도 뼈이식을 해야 하나요?: Do front-tooth implants always need bone grafting?
앞니 부위는 잇몸뼈가 얇아 뼈이식이 필요한 경우가 있습니다. 뼈가 충분하: Front tooth area often has thin jawbone and may require grafting. If bone is sufficient no graft needed; gum thickness is checked together and planned.
앞니 임플란트 후 발음이 이상해지지 않나요?: Will pronunciation change after front-tooth implants?
보철물의 두께와 형태가 발음에 영향을 줄 수 있어, 임시 보철 단계에서: Prosthesis thickness and shape can affect speech; check and adjust pronunciation during temporary prosthesis stage before final prosthesis.
앞니 임플란트도 수면으로 할 수 있나요?: Can front-tooth implants be done under sedation?
앞니 임플란트 수명은 얼마나 되나요?: How long do front-tooth implants last?
정해진 수명을 보장할 수는 없습니다. 잇몸뼈와 연조직, 씹는 힘, 흡연과: No fixed lifespan can be guaranteed. Depends on jawbone and soft tissues, chewing forces, smoking and hygiene management, so regular checkups are important.
다른 치과에서 한 앞니 임플란트를 다시 할 수 있나요?: Can a front-tooth implant from another clinic be redone?
가능한 경우가 많습니다. 기존 임플란트를 살리면서 뼈와 잇몸을 보강하는: Often possible. Methods include preserving the existing implant while reinforcing bone and gum or removing and reimplanting. Precision exam determines which is possible.
앞니 임플란트에 건강보험이 되나요?: Is front-tooth implant covered by national health insurance?
It looks like the gum above my previous front-tooth implant is separating.
If gum has receded exposing the prosthesis margin, that may be the case. Check for inflammation and bone loss and explain possible improvements like gum graft or prosthesis adjustment.
심었던 나사가 드러났는데 다시 덮을 수 있나요?: A screw I implanted is exposed; can it be covered again?
골재생술·잇몸이식을 검토할 수 있지만 항상 다시 덮을 수 있는 것은 아닙: Bone regeneration and gum graft can be considered but cannot always re-cover. Check remaining bone, inflammation and implant position and explain preservation possibilities and limits.
My front teeth look spaced with black triangles.
치아 사이를 채우던 잇몸(치간유두)이 사라진 상태입니다. 연조직 이식으로: The interdental gum (papilla) that filled the space between teeth is gone. Improve by soft tissue graft to restore volume or adjust prosthesis shape. Complete restoration to original is difficult; explain achievable range after assessment.
Front gum has receded making teeth look longer.
치은 퇴축으로 잇몸선이 내려앉은 경우입니다. 잇몸 볼륨을 회복시키는 이식: This is gingival recession causing gum line to drop. Evaluate whether grafting can restore gum volume and if heights differ left to right, adjust gum line together.
잇몸이식은 어디서 떼어 오나요?: Where is gum graft taken from?
대부분 본인의 입천장(구개)에서 채취합니다. 본인 조직이라 색과 질감이: Mostly taken from the patient's own palate (roof of mouth). As autologous tissue it matches color and texture and donor site usually heals in 1–2 weeks.
앞니 임플란트에 뼈이식과 잇몸이식을 꼭 같이 해야 하나요?: Do front-tooth implants always require both bone and gum grafts?
뼈와 잇몸이 충분하면 필요 없습니다. 부족한 경우에는 함께 계획하지만 이: If bone and gum are sufficient, they are not necessary. If deficient, both may be planned, but gum line can change after grafting so ongoing management is needed.
수술은 몇 시간 걸리나요?: How many hours does surgery take?
수술 시간은 식립 개수와 발치·뼈이식 범위, 전신 상태에 따라 달라집니다: Surgery time varies with implant number, extraction and graft scope, and systemic condition. If long sitting is difficult or multiple areas need treatment, staged procedures may be advised.
전체 치료 기간은 얼마나 걸리나요?: How long is total treatment time?
골유착과 치유에 수개월이 필요하며 뼈이식 범위와 회복 속도에 따라 달라집: Months are needed for osseointegration and healing and vary by graft scope and recovery speed. Explain expected schedule from extraction to final prosthesis after diagnosis.
잇몸뼈가 없다고 들었는데 가능한가요?: I was told there's no jawbone left — is it possible?
Consider bone graft, sinus lift or methods using remaining bone. Not all cases are possible; when severe bone loss exists explain alternatives like implant-supported dentures.
나이가 많아도, 지병이 있어도 되나요?: Even if elderly or with underlying disease, is it possible?
나이 자체는 제한이 아닙니다. 당뇨·고혈압도 조절되고 있으면 가능하지만,: Age itself is not a limitation. Diabetes and hypertension are often possible if controlled, but inform us if on osteoporosis injections or anticoagulants.
건강보험이 적용되나요?: Is it covered by health insurance?
임플란트 후 통증은 얼마나 가나요?: How long does pain after implant last?
Swelling and pain vary by surgical extent and may worsen for several days. Follow prescriptions and care; if pain worsens, fever, pus, severe swelling or continuous bleeding occur, contact us instead of waiting for scheduled appointment.
술과 담배는 언제부터 가능한가요?: When can I smoke or drink?
흡연은 골유착과 상처 치유를 방해하고 주위염 위험을 높여 금연을 권합니다: Smoking hinders osseointegration and wound healing and increases risk of peri-implantitis; quitting is recommended. Alcohol affects bleeding, recovery and medications so follow clinician’s indicated restriction period.
흡연은 골유착과 상처 치유를 방해하고 임플란트 주위염 및 실패 위험을 높: Smoking interferes with bone integration and wound healing and increases risk of peri-implantitis and failure. Quitting is important before and after surgery and for long-term maintenance.
출혈과 마취 회복을 확인하고 의료진의 식사 안내를 따르세요. 처음에는 부: Confirm bleeding and anesthesia recovery and follow clinician's eating guidance. Start with soft foods and avoid heavy force on temporary prosthesis.
전체를 하루에 다 심을 수 있나요?: Can the entire mouth be implanted in one day?
조건이 맞으면 상·하악 전체 식립도 하루에 가능합니다. 고령이거나 지병이: If conditions meet, full upper and lower implantation can be done in one day. For advanced age or systemic disease, staging by jaw may be safer.
Lifespan varies by jawbone condition, smoking, chewing forces and hygiene. No fixed period is guaranteed; regular checkups are necessary.
임플란트와 브릿지는 무엇이 다른가요?: What's the difference between implant and bridge?
브릿지는 양옆 건강한 치아를 깎아 걸치고, 임플란트는 빠진 자리에 직접: Bridge uses adjacent healthy teeth as supports and requires cutting them; implant is placed in the missing tooth site and spares adjacent teeth.
전체 고정식 보철은 필요한 위치의 임플란트를 연결하며 모든 치아 자리에: Fixed full-arch prosthesis connects implants at required sites and does not place implants at every tooth. Implant overdenture is retained via connecting attachments; compare fixation method, maintenance and cost.
임플란트를 했는데 MRI를 찍어도 되나요?: Can I have MRI after implant?
대부분의 치과 임플란트는 MRI 촬영이 가능하지만 재료와 다른 의료기기: Most dental implants are MRI-compatible but inform imaging center about materials and other devices. Artificial materials may affect images.
식립 개수와 뼈이식 여부에 따라 크게 달라집니다. 진단 후 필요한 항목만: Costs vary widely by number of implants and bone grafts. Provide written estimate including only necessary items after diagnosis and explain staged approach if applicable.
이가 하나도 없는데 임플란트가 가능한가요?: If I have no teeth at all, are implants possible?
가능한 경우가 있습니다. 필요한 위치에 임플란트를 심고 보철로 연결하며,: Possible in some cases. Place implants at necessary positions and connect with prosthesis; consider implant-supported dentures depending on remaining bone and care conditions.
틀니를 쓰다가 임플란트로 바꿀 수 있나요?: Can dentures be converted to implants?
가능합니다. 다만 틀니를 오래 사용하면 잇몸뼈가 주저앉은 경우가 많아 뼈: Possible. Long-term denture use often leads to bone resorption requiring grafting. CT first to check remaining bone.
전체 임플란트 후 예전처럼 씹을 수 있나요?: Can I chew like before after full implants?
Chewing function can improve but will not be identical to natural teeth. After final prosthesis avoid very hard or tough foods and excessive forces from bruxism.
위아래를 동시에 해도 되나요?: Can upper and lower be done simultaneously?
조건이 맞으면 가능합니다. 다만 고령이시거나 지병이 있으시면 한쪽 턱씩: Possible if conditions meet, but for elderly or those with systemic disease staging by jaw may be better for recovery.
치료받는 동안 이 없이 지내야 하나요?: Do I have to be without teeth during treatment?
임시 보철이나 임시 틀니의 사용 가능 여부를 미리 계획합니다. 초기 고정: Plan for temporary prosthesis or temporary denture use. Wearing and diet restrictions may apply depending on primary stability and graft sites.
전체 임플란트 후 관리는 어떻게 하나요?: How to care after full implants?
칫솔질과 치간칫솔로 임플란트 주변을 꼼꼼히 닦아 주셔야 합니다. 임플란트: Brush implants and use interdental brushes carefully. Implants do not get cavities but can develop peri-implantitis leading to bone loss; recommend regular checkups every 3–6 months.
전체 임플란트도 수면으로 할 수 있나요?: Can full implants also be done under sedation?
부모님이 80대이신데 전체 임플란트가 가능할까요?: My parents are in their 80s; is full-mouth implant possible?
나이만으로 결정하지 않습니다. 전신 상태·복용 약·관리 여건을 먼저 확인: Age alone is not deciding. Check systemic condition, medications and care environment; if long sitting is difficult consider staged treatment or sedation suitability.
당뇨나 골다공증 약을 먹는데 전체 임플란트가 되나요?: I take diabetes or osteoporosis medications — is full implant possible?
조절되고 있으면 가능한 경우가 많습니다. 골다공증 약은 종류와 복용 기간: Often possible if controlled. For osteoporosis medications assessment varies by drug type and duration; bring prescription to check.
거동이 불편하고 진료 협조가 어려운데 가능한가요?: Can it be done if mobility is limited and cooperation difficult?
보호자와 이동·의사소통·평소 상태를 먼저 상담합니다. 진정의 적합성과 원: First consult with guardian about mobility, communication and usual condition. Evaluate sedation suitability and in-hospital treatment feasibility; refer to other treatment environments if needed.
I delayed for years because I was scared of the dentist.
무서웠던 이유를 먼저 말씀해 주세요. 의식하진정은 가능한 선택지 중 하나: Tell us why you were afraid. Conscious sedation is one option. Start with exam and set treatment scope and progress together.
잇몸뼈가 거의 없다는데 전체 임플란트가 가능한가요?: If jawbone is almost gone, can full implants be done?
남은 뼈의 양과 형태를 확인해 골 재건과 식립 가능성을 평가합니다. 치료: Assess remaining bone amount and shape and evaluate reconstruction and implant feasibility. If treatment is difficult or burdensome explain alternatives like implant-supported dentures.
보증 제공 여부와 기간·범위·제외 조건은 병원에서 치료 전에 확인해 주세: Confirm warranty availability, period, scope and exclusions before treatment. The website does not promise an undecided warranty period. Regardless of warranty, regular checkups are important.
칫솔질과 치간칫솔로 임플란트 주변을 꼼꼼히 닦아 주셔야 합니다. 임플란트: Brush implants and use interdental brushes carefully. Implants do not get cavities but peri-implantitis can dissolve bone; check this at regular exams.
보증 기간이 지나면 어떻게 되나요?: What if the warranty period passes?
보증 여부와 별개로 정기검진은 계속 필요합니다. 문제가 생기면 상태를 확: Independent of warranty, regular checkups are still needed. If problems occur evaluate condition and explain required treatment and costs.
뺀 날 바로 다시 심을 수 있나요?: Can you replant right on the day the implant was removed?
염증 범위와 남은 뼈의 양, 초기 고정 가능성에 따라 다릅니다. 제거 당: Depends on inflammation extent, remaining bone and primary stability. Immediate placement possible in some cases but may require infection control or bone reconstruction first.
재수술도 오래 쓸 수 있나요?: Can reoperation last long as well?
실패 원인을 규명하고 함께 해결하는 것이 중요합니다. 원인을 그대로 둔: Identifying and addressing failure causes is important. Reimplanting without correcting causes may repeat problems. Reoperation also carries complication and failure risk and lifespan is not guaranteed.
다른 병원에서 한 임플란트도 봐주시나요?: Do you evaluate implants done at other clinics?
가능합니다. 타 치과에서 식립한 임플란트의 주위염·파절·잇몸 문제로 오시: Yes. Many come for peri-implantitis, fractures, or gum problems on implants placed elsewhere. Bring records or x-rays if available.
잇몸이 붓고 붉어지거나, 칫솔질할 때 피가 나거나, 임플란트 주변을 눌렀: Typical signs are swollen, red gums, bleeding when brushing, or pus when pressing around the implant. Early stages often have little pain and go unnoticed.
임플란트에서 피나 고름이 나오는데 재수술해야하나요?: If implant bleeds or has pus, must it be reoperated?
임플란트를 둘러싼 잇몸과 뼈에 염증이 생긴 상태(임플란트 주위염)일 가능: Likely inflammation of the implant surrounding gum and bone (peri-implantitis). If in the upper jaw, check for fistula to the sinus or sinusitis too.
The gum around the implant has receded and the screw is exposed.
잇몸 퇴축이나 뼈 소실 등 원인을 확인해야 합니다. 골재생술·잇몸이식으로: Check for causes like gum recession or bone loss. Evaluate whether bone regeneration or gum graft can improve it, but not all cases can be re-covered.
가능합니다. 관리 상태나 주변 잇몸뼈 상황, 이갈이 여부에 따라 픽스처나: Possible. Fixtures or prostheses can fracture depending on maintenance, surrounding bone, and bruxism. Regular checks post-implantation are important.
임플란트 재수술 비용은 처음보다 더 드나요?: Is reoperation more expensive than the first time?
제거·골 재건·재식립이 함께 필요하면 처음보다 항목이 늘어날 수 있습니다: If removal, bone regeneration and reimplantation are needed, item count may increase and cost may be higher. If existing implant can be preserved costs are lower. Provide written estimate after CT diagnosis.
If bone reconstruction is required, months may be needed for graft maturation. If removal and immediate placement are possible, the period shortens significantly.
왜 실패했는지 알 수 있나요?: Can you know why it failed?
CT로 골 결손 범위와 임플란트 고정 상태를 확인하면 대부분 원인을 좁힐: CT to check bone defect and implant stability can narrow causes in most cases. Explain causes such as peri-implantitis, bone deficiency, implant position, prosthetic mismatch, and bruxism.
임플란트 수명이 다 된 걸까요?: Is it because the implant's lifespan ended?
정해진 수명이 있는 부품처럼 판단하기보다 잇몸뼈, 보철과 부품의 상태를: Rather than treating it like a part with fixed lifespan, assess jawbone, prosthesis and component status. First check preservation possibility and necessary treatments.
재수술 후 또 실패하지 않으려면 어떻게 해야 하나요?: How to prevent repeated failure after reoperation?
금연, 잇몸 관리, 3~6개월 정기검진 세 가지가 가장 중요합니다. 이갈: Three most important are quitting smoking, gum care, and regular checkups every 3–6 months. If bruxism exists, recommend night guard.
잇몸이 내려가 나사가 보이는데 다시 덮을 수 있나요?: Gum receded and screw is visible — can it be covered again?
노출 원인과 잔존 뼈, 염증 상태를 확인해 골재생술·잇몸이식을 검토합니다: Assess exposure causes, remaining bone and inflammation, consider bone regeneration and gum graft. Complete coverage may be difficult and removal may be necessary in some cases.
There's an odor around the implant.
임플란트와 잇몸 사이에 세균이 쌓여 염증이 생긴 경우가 많습니다. 방치하: Often bacteria accumulate between implant and gum causing inflammation. Left untreated bone may resorb so early check is advised.
임플란트 크라운이 깨졌는데 다시 심어야 하나요?: Implant crown broke — do I need to re-implant?
If only prosthesis broke, check whether the main body can be retained and only the prosthesis remade. Verify if the fixture and connection parts are undamaged and investigate cause of breakage.
임플란트 나사가 부러졌다는데 어떻게 하나요?: An implant screw fractured — what to do?
부러진 나사를 제거하고 새 나사로 교체합니다. 임플란트 본체가 멀쩡하면: Remove broken screw and replace with a new one. If implant fixture is intact removal is unnecessary. Repeated screw fractures may indicate occlusion or bruxism as cause and should be checked.
드물지만 가능합니다. 이갈이가 심하거나 주변 잇몸뼈가 녹아 힘을 지탱하지: Rare but possible. Severe bruxism or surrounding bone loss reducing support can crack the fixture. This may require removal and reimplantation.
접착 부위가 약해졌거나, 나사가 풀렸거나, 교합이 맞지 않아 특정 부위에: Possible causes: weak bonding area, loose screw, or occlusion concentrating force on a spot. Identify cause before reattaching to prevent recurrence.
임플란트 주변에 단단한 잇몸이 없다고 하는데 문제가 되나요?: Is it a problem if there isn’t firm gum around the implant?
각화치은이 부족하면 칫솔질이 어렵고 염증이 반복되기 쉽습니다. 필요하면: Lack of keratinized gingiva makes brushing difficult and inflammation likely. If needed keratinized tissue grafting can create maintainable gum.
뼈가 없다고 들었는데 정말 임플란트가 가능한가요?: I was told there’s no bone — is implant really possible?
결손 형태에 따라 뼈이식으로 식립할 토대를 만들 수 있는 경우가 있습니다: Depending on defect form, bone grafting can create a base for implantation. Not possible in all cases; explain methods, timeline and limits after checking remaining bone and systemic condition.
뼈이식 후 얼마나 기다려야 하나요?: How long to wait after bone graft?
이식한 뼈가 성숙하는 데 수개월이 필요할 수 있습니다. 치유 경과와 필요: Months may be needed for graft to mature. Decide next step timing by healing course and necessary tests.
내 뼈를 쓰나요, 인공뼈를 쓰나요?: Do you use my own bone or artificial bone?
상황에 따라 다릅니다. 결손이 큰 경우 아래턱 등에서 본인의 뼈를 소량: Depends on situation. For large defects small amounts of autologous bone from sites like the lower jaw may be harvested and used with graft material. Explain materials after diagnosis.
티타늄으로 만든 얇은 그물망입니다. 이식한 뼛가루가 눌리거나 흩어지지 않: A thin mesh made of titanium. Bent to shape the bone and fixed with screws to prevent graft particles from collapsing or scattering. Used for wide defects or height reconstruction where membranes alone can't maintain shape.
티타늄 메쉬는 몸에 계속 남아 있나요?: Does titanium mesh remain in the body permanently?
치유 후 제거하는 방식으로 사용하는 경우가 많습니다. 사용한 재료와 수술: Often used with later removal after healing. Removal timing is guided by materials used and surgical plan; explain risks like exposure or infection.
차폐막은 나중에 빼야 하나요?: Do barrier membranes need removal later?
재료에 따라 다릅니다. 흡수성 차폐막은 몸에서 자연히 흡수되고, 비흡수성: Depends on material. Resorbable membranes are absorbed naturally; non-resorbable membranes, titanium mesh and fixation screws are removed after bone formation is confirmed.
뼈이식을 하면 많이 붓나요?: Does bone grafting cause large swelling?
이식 범위가 클수록 붓기가 있을 수 있습니다. 보통 2~3일째 가장 심하: Larger graft areas may cause more swelling. Typically worst on days 2–3 and subsides within a week; manage with cold packs and prescribed medications.
뼈이식 없이 짧은 임플란트로 대신할 수는 없나요?: Can short implants be used instead of bone graft?
가능한 경우가 있습니다. 남은 뼈의 양과 형태, 씹는 힘을 함께 보고 어: Possible in some cases. Decide which is advantageous by evaluating remaining bone amount and shape and chewing forces.
흡연은 이식 부위의 혈류와 치유에 영향을 주는 위험 요인입니다. 수술 전: Smoking affects blood flow and healing at graft sites and is a risk factor. Quitting before and after surgery is recommended and important for long-term maintenance.
골화가 충분하지 않으면 추가 이식이나 식립 시점 변경이 필요할 수 있습니: If ossification is insufficient additional grafting or changing implant timing may be needed. Check for infection or graft exposure and explain next steps.
예전에 심은 임플란트 주변 뼈가 녹았는데 이것도 되나요?: What about bone loss around implants placed earlier?
가능한 경우가 많습니다. 노출된 임플란트 표면을 정리한 뒤 골재생술을 더: Often possible. Clean exposed implant surface and add bone regeneration to preserve existing implant.
수면으로 받을 수 있나요?: Can this be done under sedation?
염증이 있는데 위쪽 임플란트가 가능한가요?: If there is inflammation, can upper implants be done?
못 하는 것은 아니고 순서가 다릅니다. 염증이 있는 상태에서 거상술을 하: Not impossible, but sequence differs. Performing sinus lift with inflammation increases infection risk, so clean inflammation and confirm recovery before implantation.
상악동 수술 후에 냄새가 나는데 왜 그런가요?: Why is there odor after sinus surgery?
상악동에 염증이 남아 있거나 새로 생긴 경우일 수 있습니다. 한쪽에서만: May indicate remaining or new sinus inflammation. If unilateral with nasal congestion, CBCT confirmation is needed.
I feel water going into my nose when I drink.
구강-상악동 누공 등 입과 상악동이 연결된 상태일 수 있어 신속한 진료가: May be an oroantral fistula where oral cavity and sinus are connected — urgent care needed. Do not apply pressure trying to check; treatment varies by size and inflammation.
Risks include membrane perforation, bleeding, infection and sinusitis, and graft failure. Choose method after imaging anatomical structures but cannot eliminate risk entirely.
왜 윗턱 어금니 임플란트 할때 이수술이 필요한가요?: Why is this surgery needed for upper molar implants?
윗턱 어금니 위쪽에 상악동이라는 빈 공간이 있기 때문입니다. 치아를 오래: Because there is a hollow maxillary sinus above the upper molars. Long tooth loss allows the sinus to descend reducing bone height for implants.
축농증인데 왜 치과에 가야 하나요?: If I have sinusitis why go to the dentist?
원인이 치아인 치성 상악동염일 수 있기 때문입니다. 치과 검사와 이비인후: Cause may be odontogenic sinusitis from a tooth. Dental exam and ENT evaluation help identify cause and coordinate necessary treatment.
치조정 접근법과 측방 접근법은 무엇이 다른가요?: What's the difference between crestal and lateral approaches?
치조정 접근법은 임플란트를 심을 자리에서 위로 막을 들어 올리는 방식으로: Crestal approach lifts membrane from the implant site with a smaller incision. Lateral approach creates a window in side bone and is chosen when bone height is greatly deficient or wide area needs work.
상악동 막이 찢어지면 어떻게 되나요?: What if the sinus membrane tears?
수술 중 확인해 바로 처치합니다. 범위에 따라 이식을 미루고 회복을 기다: Address immediately during surgery. Depending on extent, grafting may be postponed and allowed to heal before retrying.
남은 뼈 높이가 어느 정도 확보되면 거상술과 식립을 한 번에 진행할 수: If sufficient remaining bone height can be secured, lift and implantation can be done in one session. If height is very lacking, graft and wait for ossification before later implantation.
뼈이식 범위와 회복 속도에 따라 수개월이 걸릴 수 있습니다. 치유와 골유: Recovery may take months depending on graft scope and healing. Proceed with prosthesis after checking healing and osseointegration; schedule explained individually.
나이 자체가 제한은 아닙니다. 다만 고령일수록 전신질환을 함께 확인해야: Age alone is not a limit. For elderly patients confirm systemic diseases and medications in advance and plan accordingly.
수술 후 코를 풀어도 되나요?: Can I blow my nose after surgery?
일정 기간 코를 세게 풀지 말고, 재채기는 입을 벌리고 하며 억지로 참지: Avoid forceful nose blowing for a period and sneeze with mouth open, but do not hold sneezes. Pressure can affect surgery site; follow individual guidance.
상악동 안에 고인 농과 염증 조직을 제거하고 세정하는 수술입니다. 배농만: Surgical removal and irrigation of pus and inflamed tissue in the sinus. Performed for chronic inflammation not resolved by drainage alone.
상악동에 물혹이 있다는데 위험한가요?: Is a cyst in the sinus dangerous?
저류성 낭종은 대부분 증상이 없어 경과만 보는 경우가 많습니다. 다만 크: Retention cysts are mostly asymptomatic and monitored. But if large or when planning sinus lift they may be removed beforehand.
임플란트가 상악동으로 들어갔다는데 어떻게 하나요?: An implant entered the sinus — what to do?
상악동 안에 남아 있으면 염증의 원인이 되므로 제거해야 합니다. 위치를: If remaining in the sinus it can cause infection and must be removed. Confirm location, remove it, close the perforation and wait to re-implant later.
뼈이식과 상악동 거상술은 무엇이 다른가요?: What's the difference between bone graft and sinus lift?
뼈이식은 잇몸뼈의 폭과 높이를 재건하는 수술이고, 상악동 거상술은 윗턱: Bone graft reconstructs width and height of alveolar bone; sinus lift raises the sinus membrane to secure height in the upper molar area. They can be done together.
장애인도 임플란트를 받을 수 있나요?: Can people with disabilities receive implants?
